title: दशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 110 · Tenth day: Arjuna and the kings

summary.en: Arjuna covers the kings with arrows, and he and Bhima fight Shalya, Kripa and the Trigartas, scattering their bows and arrows. At Dhrishtadyumna's order the Pandava army rushes at Bhishma.
summary.kn: ಅರ್ಜುನ ರಾಜರನ್ನು ಬಾಣಗಳಿಂದ ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅವನೂ ಭೀಮನೂ ಶಲ್ಯ, ಕೃಪ, ತ್ರಿಗರ್ತರೊಡನೆ ಹೋರಾಡಿ ಅವರ ಬಿಲ್ಲು ಬಾಣಗಳನ್ನು ಚದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಧೃಷ್ಟದ್ಯುಮ್ನನ ಆದೇಶದಂತೆ ಪಾಂಡವ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಭೀಷ್ಮನ ಮೇಲೆ ನುಗ್ಗುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: अर्जुन राजाओं को बाणों से ढक देते हैं, और वे तथा भीम शल्य, कृप और त्रिगर्तों से लड़कर उनके धनुष-बाण बिखेर देते हैं। धृष्टद्युम्न के आदेश से पाण्डव सेना भीष्म पर टूट पड़ती है।
summary.te: అర్జునుడు రాజులను బాణాలతో కప్పుతాడు; అతడు, భీముడు శల్య, కృప, త్రిగర్తులతో పోరాడి వారి విల్లులు బాణాలను చెదరగొడతారు. ధృష్టద్యుమ్నుని ఆజ్ఞతో పాండవసేన భీష్ముని మీదకు ఉరుకుతుంది.
summary.ta: அர்ஜுனன் மன்னர்களை அம்புகளால் மூடுகிறான்; அவனும் பீமனும் சல்யன், கிருபர், திரிகர்த்தருடன் போரிட்டு அவர்களின் வில்லம்புகளைச் சிதறடிக்கின்றனர். த்ருஷ்டத்யும்னன் ஆணைப்படி பாண்டவப் படை பீஷ்மரை நோக்கிப் பாய்கிறது.
summary.ml: അർജുനൻ രാജാക്കന്മാരെ അമ്പുമഴകൊണ്ട് മൂടുന്നു; അദ്ദേഹവും ഭീമനും ശല്യർ, കൃപർ, ത്രിഗർത്തർ എന്നിവരോട് പൊരുതി അവരുടെ വില്ലും അമ്പും ചിതറിക്കുന്നു. ധൃഷ്ടദ്യുമ്നന്റെ കൽപ്പനപ്രകാരം പാണ്ഡവ സേന ഭീഷ്മരുടെ നേരെ പാഞ്ഞടുക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.110; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
अर्जुनस्तु रणे शल्यं यतमानं महारथम् ।
छादयामास समरे शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥

meaning.en: In the battle Arjuna covered the great chariot-warrior Shalya, who was striving hard, with smooth-jointed arrows.

verses.text:
सुशर्माणं कृपं चैव त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरविध्यत ।
प्राग्ज्योतिषं च समरे सैन्धवं च जयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: He struck Susharma and Kripa with three arrows each, and also Bhagadatta, and Jayadratha the Sindhu king.

verses.text:
चित्रसेनं विकर्णं च कृतवर्माणमेव च ।
दुर्मर्षणं च राजेन्द्र आवन्त्यौ च महारथौ ॥

meaning.en: Likewise Chitrasena, Vikarna, Kritavarma, Duryodhana's brother Durmarshana, and the two great warriors of Avanti, O king of kings.

verses.text:
एकैकं त्रिभिरानर्छत्कङ्कबर्हिणवाजितैः ।
शरैरतिरथो युद्धे पीडयन्वाहिनीं तव ॥

meaning.en: That supreme chariot-fighter hurt your army, striking each of them with three arrows fletched with heron and peacock feathers.

verses.text:
जयद्रथो रणे पार्थं भित्त्वा भारत सायकैः ।
भीमं विव्याध तरसा चित्रसेनरथे स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: O Bharata, Jayadratha, standing on Chitrasena's chariot, pierced the son of Pritha with arrows and swiftly wounded Bhima as well.

verses.text:
शल्यश्च समरे जिष्णुं कृपश्च रथिनां वरः ।
विव्यधाते महाबाहुं बहुधा मर्मभेदिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Shalya and Kripa, best of charioteers, in many ways wounded the mighty-armed conqueror Arjuna with arrows that pierce vital spots.

verses.text:
चित्रसेनादयश्चैव पुत्रास्तव विशां पते ।
पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिस्तूर्णं संयुगे निशितैः शरैः ।
आजघ्नुरर्जुनं संख्ये भीमसेनं च मारिष ॥

meaning.en: And your sons, Chitrasena and the rest, O lord of the people, quickly struck both Arjuna and Bhima with five sharp arrows each.

verses.text:
तौ तत्र रथिनां श्रेष्ठौ कौन्तेयौ भरतर्षभौ ।
अपीडयेतां समरे त्रिगर्तानां महद्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: There the two sons of Kunti, the best of Bharatas and of charioteers, ground down the great Trigarta force in battle.

verses.text:
सुशर्मापि रणे पार्थं विद्ध्वा बहुभिरायसैः ।
ननाद बलवन्नादं नादयन्वै नभस्तलम् ॥

meaning.en: Susharma also struck the son of Pritha with many iron arrows and roared mightily, filling the sky with the sound.

verses.text:
अन्ये च रथिनः शूरा भीमसेनधनंजयौ ।
विव्यधुर्निशितैर्बाणै रुक्मपुङ्खैरजिह्मगैः ॥

meaning.en: Other brave charioteers pierced Bhima and Arjuna with sharp, straight, gold-feathered arrows.

verses.text:
तेषां तु रथिनां मध्ये कौन्तेयौ रथिनां वरौ ।
क्रीडमानौ रथोदारौ चित्ररूपौ व्यरोचताम् ।
आमिषेप्सू गवां मध्ये सिंहाविव बलोत्कटौ ॥

meaning.en: Among those warriors the two sons of Kunti, best of chariot-fighters, shone in their splendid, varied chariots as they played, like two fierce lions in the midst of cattle seeking meat.

verses.text:
छित्त्वा धनूंषि वीराणां शरांश्च बहुधा रणे ।
पातयामासतुर्वीरौ शिरांसि शतशो नृणाम् ॥

meaning.en: Cutting the bows of the heroes and their arrows in many ways, the two heroes felled hundreds of men's heads.

verses.text:
रथाश्च बहवो भग्ना हयाश्च शतशो हताः ।
गजाश्च सगजारोहाः पेतुरुर्व्यां महामृधे ॥

meaning.en: Many chariots were smashed, hundreds of horses killed, and elephants with their riders fell to the ground in that great slaughter.

verses.text:
रथिनः सादिनश्चैव तत्र तत्र निसूदिताः ।
दृश्यन्ते बहुधा राजन्वेष्टमानाः समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Charioteers and horsemen, slain here and there, were seen writhing on every side, O king.

verses.text:
हतैर्गजपदात्योघैर्वाजिभिश्च निसूदितैः ।
रथैश्च बहुधा भग्नैः समास्तीर्यत मेदिनी ॥

meaning.en: The earth was covered with heaps of slain elephants and foot soldiers, killed horses, and chariots broken in many ways.

verses.text:
छत्रैश्च बहुधा छिन्नैर्ध्वजैश्च विनिपातितैः ।
अङ्कुशैरपविद्धैश्च परिस्तोमैश्च भारत ॥

meaning.en: It was strewn with umbrellas cut to pieces, fallen banners, discarded elephant goads and saddle cloths, O Bharata.

verses.text:
केयूरैरङ्गदैर्हारै राङ्कवैर्मृदितैस्तथा ।
उष्णीषैरपविद्धैश्च चामरव्यजनैरपि ॥

meaning.en: There were armlets, bracelets, necklaces, crushed deer-skin blankets, cast-off turbans, and chowries and fans.

verses.text:
तत्र तत्रापविद्धैश्च बाहुभिश्चन्दनोक्षितैः ।
ऊरुभिश्च नरेन्द्राणां समास्तीर्यत मेदिनी ॥

meaning.en: Here and there, arms smeared with sandal paste and thighs of kings lay scattered and covered the earth.

verses.text:
तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम रणे पार्थस्य विक्रमम् ।
शरैः संवार्य तान्वीरान्निजघान बलं तव ॥

meaning.en: There we saw a marvel, the valor of Arjuna in battle: holding those heroes off with arrows, he cut down your forces.

verses.text:
पुत्रस्तु तव तं दृष्ट्वा भीमार्जुनसमागमम् ।
गाङ्गेयस्य रथाभ्याशमुपजग्मे महाभये ॥

meaning.en: But your son Duryodhana, seeing the clash of Bhima and Arjuna, went in great fear to the side of the Ganga's son Bhishma's chariot.

verses.text:
कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च सैन्धवश्च जयद्रथः ।
विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यावाजग्मुः संयुगं तदा ॥

meaning.en: Kripa, Kritavarma, Jayadratha the Sindhu king, and Vinda and Anuvinda of Avanti then came to the battle.

verses.text:
ततो भीमो महेष्वासः फल्गुनश्च महारथः ।
कौरवाणां चमूं घोरां भृशं दुद्रुवतू रणे ॥

meaning.en: Then mighty archer Bhima and the great warrior Arjuna fiercely attacked the terrible Kaurava army in battle.

verses.text:
ततो बर्हिणवाजानामयुतान्यर्बुदानि च ।
धनंजयरथे तूर्णं पातयन्ति स्म संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Then tens of thousands and millions of arrows fletched with peacock feathers were hurled at Arjuna's chariot in the fighting.

verses.text:
ततस्ताञ्शरजालेन संनिवार्य महारथान् ।
पार्थः समन्तात्समरे प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे ॥

meaning.en: Holding those great warriors back with a net of arrows, Arjuna sent them on all sides to their deaths.

verses.text:
शल्यस्तु समरे जिष्णुं क्रीडन्निव महारथः ।
आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥

meaning.en: But Shalya, great charioteer, as though playing, angrily struck Arjuna on the chest with smooth-jointed arrows.

verses.text:
तस्य पार्थो धनुश्छित्त्वा हस्तावापं च पञ्चभिः ।
अथैनं सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भृशं विव्याध मर्मणि ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna cut his bow and the guard on his hand with five arrows, then pierced him deeply in a vital spot with sharp shafts.

verses.text:
अथान्यद्धनुरादाय समरे भारसाधनम् ।
मद्रेश्वरो रणे जिष्णुं ताडयामास रोषितः ॥

meaning.en: Then the angry king of Madra took up another bow, one able to bear the strain, and struck Arjuna.

verses.text:
त्रिभिः शरैर्महाराज वासुदेवं च पञ्चभिः ।
भीमसेनं च नवभिर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत् ॥

meaning.en: With three arrows he hit Arjuna, with five Vasudeva, and with nine Bhima, in the arms and chest, great king.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणो महाराज मागधश्च महारथः ।
दुर्योधनसमादिष्टौ तं देशमुपजग्मतुः ॥

meaning.en: Then, great king, Drona and the great warrior of Magadha, ordered by Duryodhana, came to the place.

verses.text:
यत्र पार्थो महाराज भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः ।
कौरव्यस्य महासेनां जघ्नतुस्तौ महारथौ ॥

meaning.en: There the son of Pritha and Bhima the Pandava, two great warriors, were slaughtering the vast army of the Kaurava.

verses.text:
जयत्सेनस्तु समरे भीमं भीमायुधं युवा ।
विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैरष्टभिर्भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: The young Jayatsena struck Bhima, whose weapon was terrible, with eight sharp arrows in the battle, O best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
तं भीमो दशभिर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः ।
सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन रथनीडादपाहरत् ॥

meaning.en: Bhima pierced him with ten and again with seven, and with one broad arrow knocked his charioteer from the chariot's seat.

verses.text:
उद्भ्रान्तैस्तुरगैः सोऽथ द्रवमाणैः समन्ततः ।
मागधोऽपहृतो राजा सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: With the horses bolting and running every which way, the king of Magadha was carried off in sight of the whole army.

verses.text:
द्रोणस्तु विवरं लब्ध्वा भीमसेनं शिलीमुखैः ।
विव्याध बाणैः सुशितैः पञ्चषष्ट्या तमायसैः ॥

meaning.en: Drona, finding an opening, struck Bhima with sixty-five sharp iron arrows.

verses.text:
तं भीमः समरश्लाघी गुरुं पितृसमं रणे ।
विव्याध नवभिर्भल्लैस्तथा षष्ट्या च भारत ॥

meaning.en: Bhima, who delights in battle, struck his teacher, who was like a father to him, with nine broad arrows and then with sixty, O Bharata.

verses.text:
अर्जुनस्तु सुशर्माणं विद्ध्वा बहुभिरायसैः ।
व्यधमत्तस्य तत्सैन्यं महाभ्राणि यथानिलः ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna, for his part, wounded Susharma with many iron arrows and scattered his army as the wind scatters great clouds.

verses.text:
ततो भीष्मश्च राजा च सौबलश्च बृहद्बलः ।
अभ्यद्रवन्त संक्रुद्धा भीमसेनधनंजयौ ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhishma, King Duryodhana, Shakuni and Brihadbala charged in fury at Bhima and Arjuna.

verses.text:
तथैव पाण्डवाः शूरा धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः ।
अभ्यद्रवन्रणे भीष्मं व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम् ॥

meaning.en: In the same way the Pandava heroes and Dhrishtadyumna, Prishata's son, rushed upon Bhishma in the battle, like Death with open jaws.

verses.text:
शिखण्डी तु समासाद्य भारतानां पितामहम् ।
अभ्यद्रवत संहृष्टो भयं त्यक्त्वा यतव्रतम् ॥

meaning.en: Shikhandi reached the grandsire of the Bharatas, firm in his vows, and, joyful and without fear, charged at him.

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरमुखाः पार्थाः पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम् ।
अयोधयन्रणे भीष्मं संहताः सह सृञ्जयैः ॥

meaning.en: Led by Yudhishthira, the sons of Pritha, with Shikhandi put forward, fought Bhishma in the battle together with the Srinjayas.

verses.text:
तथैव तावकाः सर्वे पुरस्कृत्य यतव्रतम् ।
शिखण्डिप्रमुखान्पार्थान्योधयन्ति स्म संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: In the same way all your men, putting Bhishma of firm vows in front, fought the sons of Pritha led by Shikhandi.

verses.text:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कौरवाणां भयावहम् ।
तत्र पाण्डुसुतैः सार्धं भीष्मस्य विजयं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then began a terrible battle of the Kauravas against the sons of Pandu, with Bhishma's victory at stake.

verses.text:
तावकानां रणे भीष्मो ग्लह आसीद्विशां पते ।
तत्र हि द्यूतमायातं विजयायेतराय वा ॥

meaning.en: O lord of the people, Bhishma was the stake of your side in that game, for the gamble there was for victory or for the other outcome.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज सर्वसैन्यान्यचोदयत् ।
अभिद्रवत गाङ्गेयं मा भैष्ट नरसत्तमाः ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtadyumna, great king, urged on all the armies: "Charge at the son of Ganga and do not be afraid, best of men."

verses.text:
सेनापतिवचः श्रुत्वा पाण्डवानां वरूथिनी ।
भीष्ममेवाभ्ययात्तूर्णं प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा महाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Hearing their commander's words, the Pandava host rushed straight at Bhishma, giving up life itself in that great fight.

verses.text:
भीष्मोऽपि रथिनां श्रेष्ठः प्रतिजग्राह तां चमूम् ।
आपतन्तीं महाराज वेलामिव महोदधिः ॥

meaning.en: And Bhishma, best of charioteers, received that charging host, great king, as the ocean receives the shore's onrush.
